FILE: app/notes/frame-step.json
```
{
  "zeroMsFrame": 16.67,
  "negativeFrame": 16.67,
  "oneMsFrame": 1,
  "fortyMsFrame": 40
}
```

I wrote `app/notes/frame-step.json` from note 16, which says `runFrameInterpolation` passes the delta in seconds and turns a delta of 0 or less into 1/60. So the 0 ms and -5 ms frames both give 1/60 s, which is 16.67 after multiplying by 1000. The 1 ms and 40 ms frames pass through unchanged, giving 1 and 40.

Pausing therefore doesn't freeze these moves: each paused frame still advances them by about 16.67 ms. I couldn't run anything, so this rests on the notes alone. I'm also assuming the "delta in seconds" is the plain ms/1000 conversion with no other adjustment, and that `app/notes/` is the right place for the file.
